content: Jesús-sapingan obunnoged-ibagi ibmar-gwag gwachamalad

Ibagwengine, obunnoged-ibagi, Jesús orosgi-dakleged-digaled-abargi-nadapgu, e-sapingan orosgi-dakleged gwane-gwane imaknadapi gusmalad, degine, e-san-onogegala e-argan-abin iir-iir-imaknadapgusmalad, geb gutedamalad.

Degi, gwen-gwen Fariseoʼmar-Jesúsʼba-nadapmaladi, Jesús-sapinganga sokarmalad: —¿Ar ibiga bemar ibmar-gwag gwane-gwane nadapmala? ¿Obunnoged-ibagi mer arbaoye igar-maisursi? Emide bemar igar-maidgi annanaimalad.
Jesús, abin-imakdegu, ega sogded: —An-sapingan igar-maidgi annanaisulid. ¿Ar bemar David-ibmar-imaksad absodisurmarsi? Deun, David, degi, e-sordamar ukumecharmargu, igi imaksamala.

”Ar David Bab-Dummadse-goled-negse dognoni gusad, degi, Bab-Dummadga-madu-uklesad guchagusad. Ar David, degi, e-sordamar a-madu gunnedsulinad, ar ade, madu-isedid. ¿Unnila dule-irwa-Babse-gormaladbi we-madu-gunnoye igar-maisursi? Degite, ¿David, degi, e-sordamar igar-noar-imaksar be insae? Suli, ar ukudba nabir madu guchamalad. Degisoggu, an-sapingan nabir imaksamarmodo.”
Geb degi, Jesús sogdebalid: “Ani Dule-Machi, obunnoged-iba-e-Dummadid.”
Jesús, dule-argan-burgwaled-nudaksad
Obunnoged-iba-baidgi, Jesús, Judíoʼmar-onmakednegse dognonigu, emar-odurdaksii gusbalid. Agine, dule-wargwen, sakwa-nuedsik-argan-burgwaled sii gusad.
Agi Garda-Narmaked-Dulemar, degi, Fariseoʼmar, Jesús-argabukwa-gusmalad, dakega, bule obunnoged-ibagi Jesús dule-nudakodibeye, adi, egi sogmalagar, obunnoged-igar-maidgi annadiiye.
Ar Jesúsʼdi nue-wisid igi binsabukmala, a-ular dule-argan-burgwaledga sogded: —Dage, neg-abarse be gwisguda. Geb agi neg-abargi dule gwisgunonikid.

Geb degi, Jesús sogded: —Ibmar-soggwen an bemarse egisbimardo: Obunnoged-ibagi ibmar-nued-imakedi, wede, ¿igar-nuedi? Ibmar-isgana-imakedi, wede, ¿igar-nuedi? ¿Igid bur-nabiri? ¿Dule-oburgwedi? ¿Dule-odurguedi? ¿Igi bemar sogsunna?
Jesús bela dulemar-dikarba-bukmalad-daksagu, dule-argan-burgwaledga sogded: —Be-argan be onak. Dule na e-argan-onakgwidgu, yog-nuguar-naded.
Dummagan-bukmalad sae-itodmalad, na sunmakarmalad, igi anmar Jesús-imakmalargebye.
Jesús, e-sapingan-bur-dummaganga-guega ambe-gakabo (12) susad
Deun, a-ibagangine, Jesús Bab-Dummadse-golega yarse nade gusad. Agi Bab-Dummadse-gorsii oibosad.
Oibosgu, eba-nanaimaladse gochad. Agi ambe-gakabo (12), e-sapingan-bur-dummaganga-guega susad. Amar-sulesad, e-sapingan-bur-dummaganye onugsanonikid.
Sulesmaladi, wemalad:
Jesús, dulemar-bukidar-nudaksad
Jesús e-sapingan-ambe-gakabogwadmala (12), e-sordagan-bamaladmala, gulluse aidenonikid. Agi nebagi dulemar-bukidar-bukwamalad. Amar, wemalad:

content.text: Amarde, bela Jesús-itogega nonimalad, degi, ega bonigan-osulogega nonimalad.

content: Agi dulemar niaburbase-nue-wiledigusmalad nudaklesmalad.
Bela dulemar-bukidar Jesús-ebubidamalad, ar ade, e-gangued-nikadba, bela dulemar-onudakdiid.
Doamargi bur-nued binsalesa

content.text: Ar bato bemardi wegi yeer itodimalad.
Ar bemargi bela-dulemar nuedbi sunmakarmalar, ¡be duledar-wilesmar!

content: Jesús sogsad, be-isdarmalad be sabgumarye
Jesús sogdebalid: “Ar bemar an-itobukmaladgardi an sogdo:
”Ar dule-wargwen wagargi be-bibyosale, wagar-baid ega be oyobalo. Dule mor-suid bei susale, mer be-mor-baid ega be uksuli guo, ega be ukbalo.
Ar doa-dule bese ibmar egichialir, ega be uko. Ar dule be-ibe-ibmar susale, mer ese be gannar bar egiso.
Ar igi-dulemar be-imakbi be abege, deyob dulemar be imakmogoed.
”Ar dulemar-be-sabmaladbi be sabguele, ¿Bab-Dummadgi ibi-nued be amiosunna? Be ibmar-nued amiosuli. Ar dulemar-isgudimalad deyob dule-e-sabmalad sabgumarmogad.
Ar dulemar-ibmar-nued-bega-imakmaladgarbi ibmar-nued be imakmogale, ¿Bab-Dummadgi ibi-nued be amiosunna? Ibnued be amiosuli. Ar dulemar-isgudidimalad amba deyob imakmarmogad.

”Ar unnila dule-gannar-bega-ibmar-ukoedgarbi be ibmar ukele, ¿Bab-Dummadgi ibi-nued be amiosunna? Ibnued be amiosuli. Ar dule-isgudimaladi dule-isgudimaladga ibmar ukdamarmogad, adi, sorba gannar ega ukbaligar.

”Degisoggu, be-isdarmalad be sabgumar, ibmar-nued ega be imakmar. Ibmar-bei-abeged ega be ukmar, mer gannar-bega-ibmar-uked edarbedii be gumalo. Ar bemarga ibmar-uklegoed bur-dummarba gued. Degine, Bab-Dummad-Bur-Birigined-e-mimmiga bemar gunonikoed. Ar Bab-Dummad bela dulemar-sunnasurdamalad, degi, dulemar-isganamar wiledakmaid.
Ar igi be-Bab, dulemar-wiledakmaimoga, ayob bemar dulemar-wiledakmarmosundo.”
Mer yogasaar be sogo, we dule-isganaye

Jesús sogdebar: “Mer yogsaar be sogo, we dule-isganaye, adi, melle Bab-Dummad deyob begi sogmogagar. Mer be sogo, we-dule-sabsur-odurdakye, adi, melle Bab-Dummad sabsur be-odurdakmogagar. Dulemar begi nossuliyob be dako, adi, Bab-Dummad egi nossuliyob bemar-dakmogagar.

”Aimarga ibmar be uko, adi, Bab-Dummad bega ibmar ukmogoed. Bab-Dummad bega ibmar-wilubsaleged-nuedgi, nue-gindilegar, nue-gwamakar, degi, nue-enargwaagwadgi ibmar ukoed. Ar be ibmar wilub-imakedgine, Bab-Dummad bega ibmar wilubsamogoed.”
Geb degi, Jesús burbar emarga ibmar sogded: “¿Ar dule-ibyasulid, sunna dule-ibyasulid-idumai guosi? Suli. ¿Ar ebobela yaa-guregedgi argwachasulir be insae? Argwachale.
”Dule-ibmar-durdaknaid geg e-sailaba dummad gued. Ar ibmar-durdaknaid obelosardi, sunna e-odurdakedyob gumogodo.”
Jesús burbar sogdebalid: “¿Ar ibiga be-gwenad-ibyagi durgan-maid magarsunna be dake? ¿Ar ibiga be-ibya-yaba-suar-maiddi akusunna be dake?

”Ar igi be-gwenadga be sogoe: ‘Be-ibya-yaba-durgan-maid an bega onogweloye.’ ¿Ar be-ibya-yaba suar-maiddina? ¡Bemar yogasaar-darba-sunmakmaladid! Suar be-ibya-yaba-maid-insa be onoge. Geb agi nabir be atakoed. Adi, agi nabir be-gwenad-ibya-yaba-durgan-maid be onogoed.”
Dule e-daedgi mag be dakmaloed
Jesús sogdebalid: “Sapi nuedile, geg san-isgana nikued, e-sanmaked nued sanmaked. Ar sapi isganale, geg san-nued nikued, e-sanmaked ichakwa sanmaked.
Ar sapimar war-wargwen na e-sanmakedgi dakleged. Ar higo-san ikogi sanmaksulid, degine, uva-san gwen sapi-ikogangi welesulid.

”Anmar-dule amba deyobmodo, dule-nued, na e-gwagegi ibmar-nued-nikadba ibmar-nued onoged. Ar dule-isganadi, na e-gwagegi ibmar-isgana-nikadba ibmar-isgana onomogad. Ar dule-sunmakedi, gwagegi-ibmar-naidba na sunmaked.”
Dulemar-neg-sobedgi Jesús sunmaksad
Jesús sogdebalid: “¿Ibiga be anse, ‘Dummadye, Dummadye,’ gormala? Ar degite an-ibmar-sogedba be dasurmalad.
”Ar bela dulemar anse danikile, an-ibmar-soged itogele, degi, eba daele, an bega sogmalo, we-dule doasunnaa dae. Weyobdo:

We-dule-gwensak na neg-sobbargu, yaa akwisad, matusur akwisad, degi, neg-e-saila akwa-birgi mesisad. Diwar noargu, diwar binnasur a-neggi yolenonikid, degite, gwen neg ogiglimaksasulid, ar ade akwasaila-birgi neg nue-sobar siid.

”Ar dule an-gayaburba-itogele, ar a-sogedba imaksasulile, adi, we-dule weyobmodo: Dule neg-sobsagu, unnila napa-birgi sobsad, neg-e-saila mesissulid. Diwar noargu, a-neggi binnasur yolenonikid, neg-ayarided, neg dummad-bibichisdo. Be itogua.”
